summary: Iteration 34 — Görüşlər Calendar feature (frontend-only). All 9 calendar acceptance criteria verified end-to-end via Playwright on the public preview URL after admin login. Toggle Cədvəl/Kalendar works; calendar grid renders 42 day cells with az-AZ month label (Aprel 2026); meetings render inline (10:00 Nicat Settarov, 14:00 Settings Admin on 2026-04-15) with green dot; clicking the day-15 cell opens day-detail-dialog showing both meetings sorted by time, with employee, company, contact, location and type/mode badges; pencil (data-testid=day-edit-{id}) closes day dialog and opens the Görüşü redaktə et modal pre-filled; prev/next month buttons and Bu ay reset all work; today's cell (26) has the green ring; weekend columns (Ş, B) are red; toggling back to Cədvəl removes the calendar from DOM and restores the table (2 rows); search filter 'zzznosuchstring__' propagates to the calendar (0 time-formatted items rendered).

design_issues.screen: Görüşü redaktə et modal (opened from calendar pencil)
issues: Əməkdaş (employee) Select shows empty value on first render even though the meeting has employee_id set — pre-existing edit-modal behaviour, NOT caused by the calendar feature; flagging only as observation

action_items: (Optional, pre-existing) Investigate why the Görüşü redaktə et modal Select for əməkdaş does not auto-populate from form.employee_id on open — unrelated to calendar work.
critical_code_review_comments: Meetings.jsx is now ~480 lines — still under the 700-line guideline. monthGrid and meetingsByDate are recomputed on every render; for small datasets this is fine, but wrapping in useMemo would be a cheap optimisation as meeting count grows.
meetingsByDate keys are raw m.date strings — relies on backend always returning YYYY-MM-DD. Confirmed working with current data.

Today highlight uses ds === todayStr where todayStr is computed via toISOString().split('T')[0] — this is UTC, not local. In timezones west of UTC near midnight it could highlight the wrong cell. Low priority since the app appears to be Asia-region focused, but worth noting.
Pencil click handler does setSelectedDay(null) then openModal(m) sequentially — verified that the day dialog cleanly closes and the edit modal opens on top.
Calendar legend (Online / Müştəri görüşü / Daxili / Digər) uses the same dotColor scale as cell dots — consistent.

data-testid coverage on calendar elements is comprehensive (view-table-btn, view-calendar-btn, meetings-calendar, cal-current-month, cal-prev-month, cal-next-month, cal-today-btn, cal-day-{date}, day-detail-dialog, day-edit-{id}) — excellent for automated testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Calendar feature is fully working. Login key in localStorage may not be 'access_token' in the public preview (token came back as null in initial probe), but the UI test flow works without needing the token. To find a date with meetings programmatically, use the in-app fetch with the actual storage key (verified visually that 2026-04-15 has 2 meetings: 10:00 Nicat Settarov + 14:00 Settings Admin). Test screenshots saved at .screenshots/calendar.png, day_dialog.png, edit_modal.png.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. All calendar acceptance criteria pass.
